choose.title: How would you like to pay?
choose.subtitle: You are paying {clinic}.
choose.direct: The money goes straight to {clinic}'s own account. Carevelo never holds it and takes nothing from it.
choose.retrying: This is a fresh attempt. Anything you started earlier is left as it is.
choose.noMethods: {clinic} has not switched on a way to pay from here yet. Call the clinic to arrange payment.

mtn_momo.label: MTN Mobile Money
mtn_momo.note: A request comes to your phone. You enter your PIN to approve it.

airtel_money.label: Airtel Money
airtel_money.note: A request comes to your phone. You enter your PIN to approve it.

card.label: Card
card.note: Your bank checks the card. Carevelo never sees your card details.

cash_at_clinic.label: Cash at the clinic
cash_at_clinic.note: Pay at the desk. A member of staff confirms it here.

notStarted.bodyAggregator: Nothing has been asked of your phone and nothing has left your account. This happens when {clinic}'s payment provider cannot be reached.
notStarted.bodyCash: Take {amount} to the clinic and give the reference below. A member of staff confirms it here once you have paid. Nothing has been paid yet.

waiting.title: Check your phone
waiting.lede: {method} has been asked to collect {amount} for {clinic}. A request should appear on the phone you pay with — enter your PIN to approve it.
waiting.ledeGeneric: {method} is still working on this payment of {amount} for {clinic}.
waiting.howLong: Most requests are approved within a minute. Some take several minutes. We keep asking for up to an hour before we say we could not find out.
waiting.checking: This page checks again by itself while it is open. You can also press Check again.
waiting.checkingLabel: Waiting for this payment to be confirmed
waiting.notPaidYet: Nothing is confirmed yet. This page will say you have paid only once {method} tells us so.
waiting.doNotPayTwice: Please do not pay for this again. If you are unsure, press Check again, or call {clinic} and give the reference below.
waiting.noRequest: If no request reaches your phone within a few minutes, you can try another way to pay.

checkout.titleUnfinished: This payment is not confirmed yet
checkout.titleCollecting: Waiting for the payment page to confirm
checkout.ledeUnfinished: We sent you to {clinic}'s payment page to pay {amount}, and you are back here. {clinic}'s payment provider has not told us yet how it ended. If you did finish paying, that confirmation can take a little while to reach us. If you did not, the same page is still waiting for you below.
checkout.ledeCollecting: You have come back from {clinic}'s payment page. It has not told us that this payment is complete yet.
checkout.doNotPayTwice: Go back to the same payment page rather than starting a new one, and do not pay {clinic} another way until you know how this one ended. Otherwise the money could be taken twice.
checkout.notPaidYet: This page will say you have paid only once the payment page tells us so.
checkout.checking: This page checks again by itself while it is open, and will update as soon as we are told how this payment ended.
checkout.startAgainTitle: If you would rather start again
checkout.startAgain: Starting again sends a fresh payment to {clinic}'s payment provider and leaves the first one as it is. If the first one did go through, paying again would take the money twice — press Check again first.

failed.title: The payment did not go through
failed.money: If money has left your account, call {clinic} and give the reference below. The clinic can check its own records against it.
failed.next: You can try again, with the same way of paying or a different one.

unresolved.title: We do not know yet whether this payment went through
unresolved.lede: There has been no answer from {method} in the time we wait. That is not the same as a failure: mobile money confirmations do arrive late, and we go on checking for up to a day.
unresolved.doNotPayTwice: Please do not pay for this again yet. If it did go through, paying again would take the money twice.
unresolved.callClinic: If you need an answer today, call {clinic} and give the reference below.
unresolved.tryAnywayTitle: If you would rather not wait
unresolved.tryAnyway: You can start a fresh attempt. The earlier one may still complete on its own, which is why calling the clinic first is the safer thing to do.

reversed.title: This payment was reversed
reversed.body: {method} reports that this payment was reversed after it went through. Call {clinic} and give the reference below — a reversal is always handled by a person.

unknownState.title: We cannot tell the state of this payment
unknownState.body: Press Check again. If it stays like this, call {clinic} and give the reference below.

receipt.title: Receipt
receipt.unavailable: The receipt could not be loaded just now. The details below are from the payment record itself.

refunds.title: If you need money back
refunds.body: Your money went straight to {clinic}'s own account, so Carevelo has nothing to give back. {clinic} makes any refund through the same provider that took the payment.
refunds.how: Ask {clinic} and give the reference below. We record that you asked and what the clinic decided.

errors.notAllowed: This clinic's system did not let us start that payment. Call {clinic} to arrange it another way.
errors.keyReused: Something is wrong with this payment attempt. Reload this page and start again.
errors.generic: We could not start that payment.
